card.name: Numbers in building energy specs
card.fires_on: The space or decimal point just before a number in technical building and energy specifications, such as carbon footprint, NRC rating, chiller size or heat pump output. It also appears on the first digit of some numbers in similar texts.

modes.label: Space before a quantity
modes.description: A space right before a measured value in engineering or sustainability text.
modes.example: the total carbon footprint of our fictitious panel is<< >>2.7kg CO2/m2

modes.label: Decimal point in NRC values
modes.description: The point after 0 in a sound-absorption rating such as 0.70.
modes.example: All materials in the calculation must have an NRC of 0<<.>>70 or higher.

card.writes: It pushes down energy and efficiency words, so the model is less likely to continue with them right after a number.
card.plain: It marks the spot just before a number in product or building specs, where a unit or value is about to follow.
